The '''H-type Nubian yacht''', also known as the '''Naboo yacht''',<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|characters|padmeamidala|Padmé Amidala}}</ref> was a small [[yacht]] used by the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]]. While not heavily armed, they were equipped with a strong [[deflector shield]].<ref name="Databank" /> [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] used at least two H-types during the [[Republic Era|Fall of the Republic]], which bore [[Color|silver]] coating to denote her status as former [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] of [[Naboo]]. [[Padmé Amidala's H-type Nubian yacht (Malevolence)|One]] was flown from [[Naboo]] to [[Tatooine]] to help [[Anakin Skywalker]] find his [[Shmi Skywalker Lars|mother]], and then to [[Geonosis]] to rescue [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]; later also being used during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> and [[Padmé Amidala's H-type Nubian yacht (Rodia)|another]] during her [[mission to Rodia]],<ref name="Bombad Jedi">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref> though in both cases the yachts were destroyed.<ref name="USW" /><ref name="Bombad Jedi" /> The ''[[Heyblibber Duck]]'' was used by [[Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]]<ref name="Jar Jar 1">[[Jar Jar 1|''Jar Jar'' 1]]</ref> and later by [[Jedi Master]] [[Kelleran Beq]] to escape [[Coruscant]] with [[Din Grogu|Grogu]].<ref name="Chapter 20">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 20: The Foundling}}</ref> During the [[Imperial Era]], the former handmaiden [[Sabé]] used [[Sabé's H-type Nubian yacht|one]].<ref name="Vader 46">[[Darth Vader (2020) 46|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 46]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
While ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' states that it had a hyperdrive class of .9 and was manufactured by the [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]],<ref name="encyc" /> ''[[Unlimited Power]]'' instead states that it had a primary hyperdrive class of 1 and was manufactured by [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated]]. This article assumes that, as an RPG product, ''Unlimited Power'' is in error.<ref name="Unlimited Power">''[[Unlimited Power]]''</ref>
